q1_issues.issue: The antecedent is sealed as the positive `(Member sk_air_1 air)` — 'if there were air' — inverting the sentence's negated existential 'if there were NO air'.
The consequent's negation ('could not live') is dropped entirely, so the sealed bundle records the positive 'people could live for ten minutes', the opposite of what the sentence says.
The live event's subject takes `Experiencer`, while the instruction set's own example ('Mia has lived in Oslo since 2019') assigns `Agent` to a live subject.
The bare-plural generic subject 'people' is dropped into the role slot as the bare class constant `person`, which the instruction set reserves for non-specific objects, not for a generic subject.
The prescribed presupposition is the antecedent bundle at strength 0.0; this instead asserts a fresh positive fact `(Member sk_air_1 air)` at strength 1.0.
`ten_minutes` is an invented constant with no class atom (an untyped referent symbol), and the tag attaches to `sk_live_1`, an event that exists only inside the seal.

q2_gaps: present/non-past subjunctive counterfactual ('If there were no X, Y could not Z') — only the past 'had V-ed / would have V-ed' form is defined as `Counterfactual`, and only the indicative form as a plain `Implication`
negated existential ('there is no air') — no representation is given for denying that anything of a class exists
negation inside a sealed term — the strength-0 `(And ...)` bundle is a top-level statement device, so a counterfactual clause that is itself negative has no way to record its polarity
a bare-plural generic subject inside a sealed clause — the prescribed `Implication` rule form cannot be nested as a seal argument
focus particle 'even' scoping over a duration/measure phrase ('for even ten minutes') — `(Even <filler> <event>)` needs a constituent symbol and a measure phrase has none
notes: Both polarity inversions together make the sealed record mean roughly the opposite of the sentence. Part of the failure is genuinely unaddressed territory (negated existential, negation under a seal), so the gap list matters as much as the defect list here.
